newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids lower.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly lower Friday in response to a drop in prices on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, dealers said.
"The board is down again and nothing is going on," said a dealer in Montana. "If they (farmers) didn't like the earlier prices, they're not going to like these."
MGE July wheat settled 3-1/2 cents lower $3.80-1/4, and other months were down 5-1/4 to 2-1/2.
Rain was expected in central Montana, and that moisture was seen aiding the development of the crop, cash merchandisers said.
The spot market for spring wheat in Duluth, Minn. was said to be firm, dealers said.
